summary: All 97 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes. All 26 Figure 2B genes matched the registered direction at 21 versus 3 months: 19 up and 7 down. The corrected proposal documents the GEO webpage challenge, reconciles the paper’s male sample-count discrepancy, and limits closure to the 26 displayed genes. It passed the repository proposal validator.
openIssues: The 26 pairs fall below the 30-pair author-concordance-v2 minimum. Exact author endpoint coefficients, P values, FDR and agreement across the full registered output remain unassessed.
